Browse characters, including merchants. Open a character page for documented details, wares, and any recorded offer conditions or locations.

== Finding characters ==
[[World generation#Finding_NPCs|World generation and finding NPCs]] distinguishes landmark zones chosen at world creation from locations placed as you enter areas. Start with [[Ranger Bhato#Location_and_access|Bhato's hideout]], [[Gurb-Gurb#Location_and_access|Gurb-Gurb's hollow]], [[Ihar#Location_and_access|Ihar's shipwreck]], or [[World generation#Scaal's_lair|Scaal's lair zone]].

== Scope ==
NPC is a browsing category, not a guarantee of friendliness, dialogue availability, or survival. Deceased characters are identified on their own pages.

[[Unwanted Guard]] is included only as an inferred character grouping; read its availability caveats rather than assuming a normal encounter or dialogue.
